name: Seed Junky | 1g Pre-Roll | Scented Marker
description:
As nostalgic as a sun-faded mural in Old Town, Scented Marker brings loud, funky flavor and undeniable presence. Bursting with fruity candy and gas, this strain writes its name across your senses-bold, euphoric, and unforgettable. Perfect for leaving your mark. 

Pineapple Fruz x Permanent Marker
